what: Several photo cells flip one at a time, starting 3s in and repeating every 4.5s. Each turns over in .8s (cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1)) to show a back photo, and 1s later the previous cell returns to its front. Only one cell is ever on its back, so the mosaic changes one tile at a time like day ↔ night. Each cell turns on the Y axis (horizontal cells) or the X axis (data-axis="x"Runs on )

options.back: Time until the front panel returns after flipping (ms), default 1000
options.start: Time until the first cell flips (ms), default 3000
options.pause: If this css selector is in the document, that step is paused (original: body.is-scrolled — when the center column has been scrolled down more than 800px)
options.--fx-dur·--fx-ease·--fx-perspective: Flip duration, curve and perspective (css variables), default .8s · cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1) · 1200px
options.[data-fx-part=tile]: Cell to flip — data-axis="x" Plane X axis
options.[data-fx-part=front]·[data-fx-part=back]: Front and back faces inside a cell (the back is layered over the front)
